blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Cebu Provincial government is considering solar power installations in all 16 provincial hospitals and the procurement of ₱104 million worth of water-treatment equipment as the province prepares for possible power interruptions and water shortages during the looming El Niño.
